title: Breaking Bad
note: Written by Claude for Watch Together. Moments are approximate (fraction of the runtime, in scene order).

items.fact: Vince Gilligan pitched the show as turning 'Mr. Chips into Scarface' - this lecture is the 'Mr. Chips' half.

entries.title: Breaking Bad – Crazy Handful of Nothin' (S1E6)

items.fact: Walt's alias 'Heisenberg' refers to physicist Werner Heisenberg, of the uncertainty principle.
Bob Odenkirk's Saul was planned as a small role - he later got his own prequel series. 'Saul Goodman' = 'S'all good, man.'
Jonathan Banks's monologue is one of Mike Ehrmantraut's best-known scenes - and it decides how this episode ends.

cue: i am the one who knocks
items.fact: 'I am the one who knocks' became one of the show's signature lines - the moment Skyler sees who Walt has become.
The season's mystery is answered in the very last shot - watch the plant by the pool.

entries.title: Breaking Bad – Live Free or Die (S5E1)

items.fact: 'Yeah, Mr. White! Yeah, science!' - Aaron Paul's line became one of the show's biggest catchphrases.
'Say my name.' 'Heisenberg.' 'You're goddamn right.' - one of the most quoted exchanges in TV history.
Directed by Rian Johnson (Star Wars: The Last Jedi), this episode is often ranked the greatest TV episode ever made.

cue: i liked it i was good at it
items.fact: Walt finally admits the truth. 'Felina' is an anagram of 'finale' and a nod to Feleena in Marty Robbins' 'El Paso'.
